name: plugin-cubesmart-tenant-context
description: Twilio Flex plugin that renders the CubeSmart tenant context and live call intelligence handed over by the voice AI agent.

scripts.deploy: twilio flex:plugins:deploy --major --changelog "CubeSmart tenant context panel" --description "Renders the voice AI handoff context on the agent desktop"
scripts.release: twilio flex:plugins:release --name "CubeSmart tenant context" --description "Enable the CubeSmart tenant context panel" --plugin plugin-cubesmart-tenant-context@1.0.0
